tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Submit one factual claim to ProofMart and get back a verdict (TRUE / FALSE / MIXED / UNVERIFIED), a confidence score (0-100), the evidence behind the verdict, and a signed receipt. Verdicts are remembered in ProofMart's Ledger: a claim that was already checked and is still fresh is answered instantl

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: The ProofMart menu: each plan's monthly check bundle and draft price. Free to call — no key needed, nothing metered. Useful when an owner asks what subscribing would get them.
